faq_candidates.question: Is Levy a town, and who covers a Levy address for city or county services?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Levy is an unincorporated community, not a town.
answer_facts: Levy is an unincorporated community in southern Jasper County (Wikipedia): no town government of its own.

Jasper County Planning and Building handles county permits; the Town of Ridgeland and City of Hardeeville each run their own permit offices. Whether a given Levy parcel lies inside Hardeeville limits is NOT found: Hardeeville has annexed parcels from unincorporated Jasper County one at a time (council agendas, search summary) and grew from 5 sq mi in 2000 to over 45 sq mi by 2010 (Wikipedia, search summary). Parcel check: Jasper County GIS/assessor or Hardeeville planning.
Keep to jurisdiction only; permit content stays with the Ridgeland FAQ.

faq_candidates.question: How do I check whether my Levy home is in a flood zone?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Levy sits at 13 ft elevation in southern Jasper County (Wikipedia). Weak on portability: the process is county-wide.
answer_facts: Jasper County's Planning and Building forms-and-links page points to FEMA's Map Service Center and a 'Find your flood zone' link (search summary; not opened). Effective county Flood Insurance Study dated October 18, 2019, community 450112, covering unincorporated Jasper plus Hardeeville and Ridgeland (search summary).
Planning and Building: 358 Third Avenue Room 202, Ridgeland; 843-717-3650; Mon-Fri 9-5.
No source says whether a re-roof triggers flood rules - answer limited to where to look up the zone.

faq_candidates.question: (fallback) Do Levy homeowners qualify for SC Safe Home roof grants?
faq_candidates.why_this_town: Levy is in Jasper County. Fails portability (county-level, not Levy).
answer_facts: SC Safe Home (SC Dept of Insurance) funds roof retrofits for coastal owner-occupied single-family homes; earlier coverage lists Beaufort and Jasper among eligible counties (may be out of date); roof award $7,500 non-matching / $6,000 matching, must meet FORTIFIED Roof retrofit guidelines; 2026 window opened Feb 10. Official SC Safe Home/SCDOI page NOT read - re-verify before use.
